## Release v0.1.6

- Fixed a bug where saturation would be used to heal every tick, rather than following the 10 tick timer.
- **[1.20]** First version with 1.20.X support. I tested 1.20.1 and 1.20.6, so all 1.20.X versions _should_ work.
    - Note: Due to changes between 26.2 and 1.20.X, this version has client code and a server handshake when connecting to multiplayer to prevent desyncs.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/KeeningDawn/configurable-hunger/compare/0.1.5...0.1.6

releases.notes:
## Release v0.1.4 and v0.1.5

Initial public release.

- I forgot to make an icon, so 0.1.5 is just an icon patch.
- Allows decoupling the world difficulty from hunger difficulty via configurable settings.
    - A global toggle that will enable/disable the mod in general.
    - A toggle to enable/disable hunger depletion across all difficulties.
    - An options setting to adjust what difficulty starvation's effects will be based on.
    - An options setting to adjust when to apply peaceful's unique regeneration effect, if at all.
- Should work in most modpacks to allow you to configure hunger to your liking.

Report any bugs or request features on the [issues](https://github.com/KeeningDawn/configurable-hunger/issues) tab (github).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/KeeningDawn/configurable-hunger/commits/0.1.4
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/KeeningDawn/configurable-hunger/compare/0.1.4...0.1.5
